name: Track Irregularity Stochastic Model
definition_zh: 利用 Karhunen–Loève 展开和混沌多项式表达轨道不平顺随机过程的特定模型，可用于压缩实测不平顺信号并识别其相关性。
scope_note: TISM 指轨道不平顺随机模型，与 TIPM 所指概率模型分别保留。
usage_overview: 这里指以 K–L 展开等方式压缩实测不平顺信息的特定模型，主要用于不平顺随机模拟，并与概率模型比较所生成的激励及动力响应分布；不能泛指一切轨道不平顺的随机生成方法。

complete_examples.text: In addition to the validation by filed experimental data, a further validation is conducted by comparing with another effective model, namely the track irregularity stochastic model (TISM) developed by Perrin et al. [15] .

Based on the vehicle-track coupled dynamics theory, the calculation results between the track irregularity probabilistic model and track irregularity stochastic model was compared from the aspects of the simulated amplitude of track irregularity and the probability density distribution for dynamic response in the vehicle-track system to verify the validity and high efficacy of the track irregularity probabilistic model.

Perrin等提出的轨道不平顺随机模型(Track Irregularity Stochastic Model, TISM)主要利用Karhunen-Loève(K-L)展开和混沌多项式来表达轨道不平顺随机过程,实现了对大量实测不平顺信号的压缩与相关性识别 [7]; Panunzio等采用几乎与文献[7]相同的方法建立了轨道不平顺随机模型,并开展了车辆动力学的相关研究 [8];Lestoille等结合TISM,采用自回归滑动平均模型(Auto-Regressive Moving Average Model, ARMA)和最小二乘法模拟了轨道不平顺的时变规律,分析了列车的长时效动力性能 [9]。
